name: realm-map-v2
prompt: Create a beautiful wide landscape fantasy strategy game WORLD MAP background, top-down illustrated pixel-art cartography with finely textured painterly pixel clusters, grounded gloomy atmosphere but readable. A single broad continuous island fills most of 3:2 canvas surrounded by dark desaturated teal ocean, narrow irregular coastline. Green golden open farmlands in center, dark forests west, snow mountains north, volcanic crags northeast, brown highlands east, blue marshes southeast, harbor coves south. Winding rivers, subtle winding roads connecting clear open settlement sites, a few tiny ruined stone structures. Strong elegant geography, no visual clutter, avoid dense tiny details. Moody mist soft edges, moonlit smoky green palette with restrained gold earth and blue rivers. This is a GAME MAP BACKGROUND: no text, no symbols, no markers, no borders, no title, no compass, no UI. Large central traversable landmass, no giant sea gaps between regions.
